From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Kickoff for Acme Analytics — Draft RACI & agenda

Team —

I put together a first-pass MAP and a kickoff agenda for Acme Analytics (attached). Goal here is to align on roles, decision owners, and a realistic close timeline before we loop in Lena and Tom. Key asks:

- Please review the RACI sheet (tab "RACI_v2"). Mark yourself as R / A / C / I where appropriate.
- Call out any missing stakeholders on their side we should request (Procurement? Security contact?).
- Review the proposed milestones and timelines (Q1 evaluation + procurement windows) — flag anything unrealistic.

Attachments: acme_map_draft_v2.xlsx, kickoff_agenda_v1.docx

Proposed important milestones:
- MAP kickoff (week of 2/16) — intro, success criteria, timeline
- Eval environment provisioned (by 2/23) — infra + test datasets
- Performance evaluation complete (by 3/6) — latency/cost targets
- Procurement & contract sign (target 3/26)

I left a placeholder for legal and security review owners; Steph, can you propose folks to loop? Connor — can you sanity-check the evaluation schedule relative to our environment availability? Marissa — would you lead commercial milestones and ownership of procurement path? Neha — can you coordinate with Solutions on test dataset requirements?

I want to finalize and send a customer-facing MAP (and calendar invite) by EOD Thursday 2/12.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff for Acme Analytics — Draft RACI & agenda

Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline:

- RACI: I tagged myself as "A" for commercial approvals and moved Procurement (Acme) to "C" — they usually want a single point on our side.
- Timeline: Procurement target of 3/26 is OK but we should add a 1-week buffer for legal redlines; recommend target contract signature = 4/2 to be safe.
- Pricing: I'll prepare a short one-pager with list pricing vs committed usage scenarios to attach to the MAP.

I left comments on the spreadsheet around billing contact and discount cadence. Happy to take the procurement owner role in the MAP and run the procurement checklist once legal gives the green light.

- Marissa
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Team —

Solid start. A couple technical items to flag before we present to Acme: 

- Eval environment: we need confirmation that their infra team can open the necessary ports and that they can provide a representative sample dataset by 2/20. If not, our timeline slips.
- Metrics: suggest we add two explicit success metrics in the MAP: 95th percentile generation latency < 400ms and embedding similarity recall >= 0.88 on their eval set.
- Sandbox access: I put a short note in the sheet that Solutions will need an AWS account ID or temporary creds.

If we can get those commitments, I think the 3/26 procurement milestone (Marissa's buffer to 4/2) looks fine.

Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the draft. A few security/legal items: 

- Legal: we should loop in Legal early (I recommend copying in legal@redwood.com) so they can prepare standard SOW + data processing addendum.
- Security: request that Acme share their SOC 2 scope and any specific data residency requirements. I've added a "Security review" milestone to the MAP with owner = "Security (TBD)".
- Evidence pack: I can assemble an evidence pack (network diagrams, encryption-at-rest notes) — ETA 3 business days after kickoff.

I think we're good to send the customer-facing MAP once we add legal and security owners and confirm procurement owner (Marissa).
